name.local: みずほキャピタル株式会社

funds.name: Mizuho Life Science Fund No.1 (みずほライフサイエンス第1号投資事業有限責任組合)

strategy.thesis: Mizuho Capital, the venture capital arm of Mizuho Bank, is a generalist growth investor that in January 2020 launched a dedicated ¥10 billion Mizuho Life Science Fund No.1 targeting drug discovery, biotech, regenerative medicine, cell therapy and medical devices, evidencing an active in-house health-investing practice alongside its broader tech/growth mandate.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Fund provides R&D funding and business-model-building support for life-science growth companies; GP is Mizuho Capital, LP is Mizuho Bank.

summary.en: Mizuho Capital is the VC arm of Mizuho Bank; alongside its generalist growth-equity investing, it runs a dedicated ¥10bn Life Science Fund No.1 (est. Jan 2020) backing drug discovery, regenerative medicine, cell therapy and medical device companies.
summary.local: みずほキャピタルはみずほ銀行系のベンチャーキャピタルで、総合的な成長投資に加え、2020年1月に創薬・バイオ・再生医療・細胞治療・メディカルデバイスを対象とする100億円規模の「みずほライフサイエンス第1号ファンド」を設立し、ヘルスケア領域への投資を積極的に行っている。

name.local: 三菱UFJキャピタル株式会社

funds.name: Mitsubishi UFJ Life Science Fund No.1 (三菱UFJライフサイエンス1号ファンド)

strategy.thesis: MUCAP, MUFG's megabank-affiliated generalist VC, operates a dedicated Life Science division and has run the ¥10bn Mitsubishi UFJ Life Science Fund No.1 since February 2017, financing academic drug-discovery spinouts, pharma carve-outs and project financing across drug discovery, regenerative medicine and medical devices including digital health.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Dedicated Life Science department staffed with sector specialists supporting academia-derived drug discovery (アカデミア創薬), pharma carve-outs, and project financing through clinical development.

summary.en: Mitsubishi UFJ Capital (MUCAP) is MUFG's generalist VC arm; it has run a dedicated ¥10bn Life Science Fund No.1 since 2017, investing in drug discovery, regenerative medicine and medical devices (including digital health) via a specialist Life Science division.
summary.local: 三菱UFJキャピタルはMUFG系の総合系ベンチャーキャピタルで、2017年設立の100億円規模「三菱UFJライフサイエンス1号ファンド」を通じ、専門のライフサイエンス部が創薬・再生医療・医療機器（デジタルヘルス含む）分野に投資している。

name.local: SBIインベストメント株式会社

funds.name: SBI 4&5 Fund (SBI 4＆5投資事業有限責任組合)

strategy.thesis: SBI Investment, the VC arm of SBI Group investing broadly across AI, blockchain, fintech, IT and life sciences, has invested in bio/healthcare startups since 2003 and directed roughly 15-20% of its ¥100bn 'SBI 4&5' fund (launched April 2021) — one of Japan's largest VC funds — specifically to the bio/healthcare sector.

summary.en: SBI Investment is SBI Group's large generalist VC platform; it has invested in bio/healthcare since 2003 and allocated roughly 15-20% of its ¥100bn 'SBI 4&5' fund (2021) to bio/healthcare, and maintains a dedicated life-science/healthcare/environment portfolio filter on its site.
summary.local: SBIインベストメントはSBIグループの総合系ベンチャーキャピタルで、2003年以降バイオ・ヘルスケア分野に投資を行っており、2021年に組成した1000億円規模の「SBI 4＆5ファンド」の15～20％をバイオ・ヘルスケア分野に充てている。

summary.en: DBJ Capital is the early-stage VC arm of Japan's state-owned Development Bank of Japan; it runs a dedicated 'Bio & Healthcare' investment vertical alongside FrontierTech and IT, with portfolio companies including Scohia Pharma, Kyulux, RadioNano Therapeutics, Karydo TherapeutiX and Regimmune.

name.local: グローバル・ブレイン株式会社

strategy.thesis: Global Brain, one of Japan's largest independent multi-sector VCs, names healthcare/medical as one of its core Deep Tech investment themes alongside AI and climate tech; healthcare was reported as its largest single sector by investment share in 2024.

summary.en: Global Brain is a major Japanese generalist VC (450+ portfolio companies, 42 IPOs, 89 M&A exits) that names healthcare/medical as one of its core Deep Tech investment themes alongside AI and climate tech, with healthcare reported as its largest single sector by 2024 investment share.
summary.local: グローバル・ブレインは日本有数の独立系総合ベンチャーキャピタルで、投資先450社以上、IPO42件・M&A89件の実績を持ち、AI・Climate Techと並んで医療・ヘルスケアをコアのDeep Tech投資テーマの一つに位置づけている。

name.local: JICベンチャー・グロース・インベストメンツ株式会社

strategy.thesis: JIC VGI, the growth-stage VC subsidiary of state-backed Japan Investment Corporation (JIC), sets aside dedicated ¥15bn early-stage allocations each for life sciences and deep tech, and has backed bio/healthcare companies including Trejem Biopharma (dental regenerative therapeutics), Henry (hospital core operating systems) and Beren Therapeutics (cyclodextrin-based drug discovery).

summary.en: JIC Venture Growth Investments is the growth-VC arm of Japan's government-backed Japan Investment Corporation; it earmarks a dedicated ¥15bn early-stage life-science allocation and has invested in bio/healthcare companies such as Beren Therapeutics, Henry and Trejem Biopharma.
summary.local: JICベンチャー・グロース・インベストメンツは官民ファンド産業革新投資機構(JIC)傘下の成長投資VCで、ライフサイエンス分野に150億円のアーリーステージ投資枠を設け、Beren Therapeutics、ヘンリー、トレジェムバイオファーマ等のヘルスケア企業に投資している。

name.local: 日本ベンチャーキャピタル株式会社

strategy.thesis: NVCC, founded in 1996 by entrepreneurs and major corporations to support venture creation, is a generalist VC spanning IT, medical/biotech and environmental-energy sectors; it established a dedicated digital-health-focused fund in 2023 and runs university-linked funds with Kyoto, Osaka and Nagoya universities that source medical/life-science deal flow.

summary.en: NVCC (Japan Venture Capital) is a generalist Japanese VC founded in 1996 spanning IT, medical/biotech and clean energy; it launched a dedicated digital-health fund in 2023 and runs university-affiliated funds with medical/life-science deal flow from Kyoto, Osaka and Nagoya universities.
summary.local: 日本ベンチャーキャピタル（NVCC）は1996年設立の総合系ベンチャーキャピタルで、IT・医療バイオ・環境エネルギー分野に投資しており、2023年にデジタルヘルス特化ファンドを設立、京都大学・大阪大学・名古屋大学等との大学連携ファンドも運用している。
